listing.name: Armored Core — AC1Recomp (NeonLightning)
listing.summary: The project describes settings, controller and mod enhancements. Full-campaign completion is unconfirmed; Portcove has not confirmed these features in play. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Armored Core PlayStation USA SCUS94182 disc. This guide does not include the exact accepted disc hashes; check the project’s game.toml requirements before preparing it.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s CMake/Ninja source-build instructions for the included player and launcher, including the psx-runtime target. Select your own matching disc in the launcher. scripts/build_release.sh packages Linux x64 builds. Portcove has not inspected a prebuilt archive.

warnings: The project describes settings, controller and mod enhancements. Full-campaign completion is unconfirmed; Portcove has not confirmed these features in play.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
